#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>
#include <utility>

using namespace std;

const long double EPS = 1e-40;

int main()
{
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    pair<long long, long long> ans;
    long long x, y, n, a, b;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    double xbyy = static_cast<double>(x) / static_cast<double>(y);

    for (long long b = 1; b <= n; b++) {
        double ald = xbyy * static_cast<double>(b);
        double diff1, diff2;
        long long a1, a2;
        a1 = static_cast<long long>(ald);
        a2 = a1 + 1;
        diff1 = xbyy - static_cast<double>(a1) / static_cast<double>(b);
        diff2 = static_cast<double>(a2) / static_cast<double>(b) - xbyy;
        if (abs(diff - diff1) > EPS) {
            ans.first = a1;
            ans.second = b;
            diff = diff1;
        }
        if (abs(diff - diff2) > EPS) {
            ans.first = a2;
            ans.second = b;
            diff = diff2;
        }
    }
    cout << ans.first << "/" << ans.second;
    return 0;
}
